name: Edition 2026.10.4: Highlights, Cheat Sheets, and SGLang
body:
Highlight what matters, keep notes beside the text, and carry a compact reference into your next build. This edition adds a reading workspace, 154 cheat sheets, and the ready edition of SGLang 101. [Start learning](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com) · [Cheat sheets](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/cheatsheets) · [SGLang 101](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/manual-sglang-101.html) ## Highlights and notes Select text in a lesson or manual, choose one of four colors, and add a note. Open My Highlights to search, filter, jump back to a passage, or manage several highlights together. - Export Markdown for your notes or JSON for backup and import. - Move highlights between devices with a sync file or share link. - Review uncertain matches when a passage changes. - Use the same tools on mobile, in light and dark themes, and with forced colors. Highlights stay in your browser. Use an export or share link to move them elsewhere. ![Highlight colors and notes in a lesson](https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/releases/download/v2026.10.4/highlights-dark.png)
Light theme, mobile, and accessibility screenshots ![Adding a note in light theme](https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/releases/download/v2026.10.4/highlights-notes-light.png) ![Highlights with forced colors enabled](https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/releases/download/v2026.10.4/highlights-accessibility.png)
## 154 cheat sheets Find commands, formulas, diagrams, defaults, and troubleshooting notes across all 542 lessons, four manuals, and 78 projects. Browse 12 tracks or search by topic, task, command, or term. Follow a source link when you need the full explanation. The complete collection is attached as **aiefs-cheatsheets.pdf**. ![Transformers and attention cheat sheet](https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/releases/download/v2026.10.4/cheatsheet-transformers-attention.png)
Agent harness cheat sheet ![Agent harness engineering cheat sheet](https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/releases/download/v2026.10.4/cheatsheet-agent-harness.png)
## SGLang 101 is ready Serve a model, size its KV cache, measure the concurrency knee, and decide when to split work across GPUs. The manual covers SGLang 0.5.22 in 28 sections plus six reference sections, with 63 figures and a cover plate. The examples distinguish measured results from code defaults and reported claims. This edition includes Apple Silicon, GB10, cooled L4, and Miles rollout evidence, including CUDA graphs, attention backends, and three training seeds. Read it online or download **aiefs-manual-sglang-101.pdf** below. ## More in this edition - A beginner guide and 142 exercise hints across 34 lessons in Phases 0 and 1. - Project selection by role and lesson search inside phase dialogs. - Reverse Engineering 101 updated for rea 6.7.0. - Improved article navigation on smaller screens and a clean roadmap URL. - Fixes for links containing parentheses, PDF math rendering, and deployment bundles. ## Downloads All six English books are included in PDF and EPUB. The four manual PDFs cover A2A, Docker Sandboxes, Reverse Engineering, and SGLang. The complete cheat-sheet PDF and six preview images are also attached. ## Thanks to our contributors Thank you to @Abhishek-1337 for lesson search in phase dialogs, @AkshayKathiriya and @dajiaohuang for fixes to links containing parentheses, and @ALANDVO for adding lesson summary cheat-sheet support. Thanks also to everyone who reported problems, reviewed changes, and helped improve the course. [Full changelog](https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/compare/v2026.10.3...v2026.10.4)
